csv_row.description: Use when fixing HustleXP revenue collection bugs including Stripe platform fee not being collected (application_fee_amount missing), escrow fee miscalculation using task.price instead of escrow.amount, self-insurance pool never funded, tip platform cut absent, subscription renewal revenue not logged, or XP tax path unreachable. Covers all platform fee issues and financial invariant checks.
